market.label: target-market

event_note: seen in the site code, Nov 22

enquiries.label: Treatment enquiries
enquiries.how: Count of the generate_lead event, which the site sends once the enquiry form confirms a treatment enquiry.
caveats: Sent only for visitors who allow optional cookies ({note}); other enquiries reach the inbox but not Analytics.
Enquiries by phone, email or WhatsApp are not counted here.
breakdowns: Page the enquiry was sent from
enquiries.reading: Match each enquiry to its reply so none goes unanswered.
enquiries.test: Accept optional cookies, send one test enquiry, and check generate_lead in Analytics Realtime.

enquiries.label: WhatsApp clicks
enquiries.how: Count of the whatsapp_click event the site sends.
caveats: Sent only for visitors who allow optional cookies ({note}).
A click opens WhatsApp; it does not prove a message was sent.
enquiries.test: Tap a WhatsApp button after accepting cookies and check whatsapp_click in Analytics Realtime.

authority_steps: Get listed on medical-travel directories such as Treatment Abroad, WhatClinic and Bookimed.
Earn one link from a German or Gulf health publication.
ga_caveat: Counted only for visitors who allow optional cookies in the site's banner; Search clicks show the fuller picture.
